hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *git\ diff*|*git\ show*|*git\ log*) ;; *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify-out/graph.json exists. `graphify query \"<question>\"` returns a scoped subgraph and is usually cheaper than grepping raw files. Reviewing a diff is exempt \u2014 the diff is the evidence."}}'   || true ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);exts=('.py','.js','.mjs','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.astro','.vue','.svelte','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh');vals=[str(t.get('file_path') or ''),str(t.get('pattern') or ''),str(t.get('path') or '')];j=' '.join(vals).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');tails=[('.'+x.rsplit('.',1)[-1]) for v in vals if v for x in [v.lower().replace(chr(92),'/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]] if '.' in x];sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in j and any(tl in exts for tl in tails) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify-out/graph.json exists. To locate code, `graphify query \"<question>\"`, `graphify explain \"<concept>\"`, and `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"` return names and line numbers for far fewer tokens than reading files. They are a locator, not a substitute for reading the code you are about to change or review."}}'; fi || true
